Based on 4,116 Hennepin County arms-length sales (county='Hennepin', sale_month ≥ 2016-07, `arms_length`=true, `multi_parcel_deed` null) with a non-null parcel-level assessed value (confirmed the `sales.assessed` field matches the `parcels.assessed` field exactly for the same parcel), the median of (sale price ÷ assessed value) = **1.003**.
